method: Deterministic compatibility regression using retained 24h trades, frozen policies and recorded entry quotes. Admission drawdown held fixed. Sparse path/event reconstruction is deliberately not a causal backtest and is not used to qualify the timing policy.
deploymentScope: Audit labels, transactional entry pricing/admission snapshots, and disabled opt-in timing implementation. No timing cells enabled.
timingDecision: Not qualified: no complete causal entry-depth and queue history to establish unchanged or better net profit. No performance claim.
